highlights: Staff training on data protection and safeguarding
Health and welfare information collection for safeguarding
Role-based permissions in portals and encrypted connections
safety.policy_summary: The school outlines a comprehensive privacy and safeguarding policy addressing the collection and protection of student pastoral, health, and welfare information. It incorporates technical and organizational measures such as access controls, encrypted connections, and staff training on data protection and safeguarding in compliance with the Thailand Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
